text:
acme-admin: Hey team — after the role refactor this morning my billing and model permissions disappeared. I can still log into the console but I get 403 on /billing and model deploys. 😕
lia: Sorry about that — can you paste your org/username and one example request ID? I'll escalate.
acme-admin: org=acme-inc, user=alice.w, request 987654321 (console request id shows 403). Happened ~08:12 UTC after we accepted the new role sync prompt.
samir: @lia thanks, tagging in security. Any chance the role attributes from our IdP changed? We pushed attribute-based role matching yesterday.
opsbot: rbac-sync-job (rolesync/worker-3) started 2026-05-03T08:05:03Z
opsbot: rbac-sync-job (rolesync/worker-3) finished 2026-05-03T08:05:07Z exit=1
kevin: I pulled the sync logs — there was an attribute mapping error: "missing attribute 'department' for user alice.w" and then the job aborted.
jake: That matches an observed regression in the migration: the new mapping requires `department` -> `org_unit`, but our IdP only supplies `orgUnitPath` for some customers. Looks like a mismatch for acme-inc.
samir: Oof. So users who lacked the expected attribute got no roles assigned, which causes 403s. We need a mitigation for the customer and a fix in the mapping.
lia: Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily grant alice.w the org-admin role so she can access billing and models, 2) re-run rolesync in permissive mode for acme-inc, 3) patch mapping and run a full resync. OK to proceed? @acme-admin
acme-admin: yes please, need billing access ASAP.
jake: I'm running a targeted permissive sync now. Command: ```rbac-sync --tenant acme-inc --mode permissive --log-level debug --force```
opsbot: rbac-sync task queued (task id 0x7b4a), running on rolesync/worker-2
opsbot: rbac-sync completed (task id 0x7b4a) exit=0 updated=142 users
kevin: I just applied a temporary grant: set-role alice.w org-admin ttl=2h reason="emergency support: rolesync attr gap". Please verify.
acme-admin: Verified — billing and model deploy work again, thanks. 🙏
samir: Root cause: attribute name change in our mapping + no fallback for missing attributes. Action items: 1) rollback strict mapping and add fallback rules (jake), 2) add alert on >0% users without roles post-sync (kevin), 3) add a unit/integration test for IdP attribute permutations (samir).
jake: I'll open PR to change mapping to check orgUnitPath, department, then fallback to static mapping. Will include migration script to re-run for affected tenants.
kevin: I'll add CloudWatch/SLO alert: rolesync-missing-role-rate > 0.1% over 5m => pager.
lia: I'll send customer a summary and close the escalation once we have the PR link and scheduled resync time.
samir: One more note for audit: record temporary grant as a KMS-protected audit entry and mark ticket number in the revoke workflow.
lia: Thanks everyone — acme-admin, leaving initial message here in case you want confirmation notes later.
acme-admin: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround! :thumbsup:
